title: Acyclic Leray for derived evaluation without Ext
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and i: X.Opens -> X.Etale a continuous finite-limit-preserving functor with additive sheaf pushforward T [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let Z evaluate an abelian Zariski sheaf at the top open, and E evaluate an abelian etale sheaf at i(top). For all etale sheaves F [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with R^(n+1)T(F)=0 for every n >= 0, there exist simultaneously additive equivalences c(F,hF,n): R^(n+1)Z(T(F)) -> R^(n+1)E(F), natural for all morphisms between these T-acyclic sheaves. No HasExt model, free representable, constant integer sheaf, or terminality hypothesis appears in this statement.

proof.text: Finite-limit preservation makes i representably flat (Mathlib flat_of_preservesFiniteLimits). Apply the universe-general source-library theorem preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_of_flat directly with AddCommGrpCat coefficients: the comma categories have the size of the opens and etale homs, so no small model of the etale object category is required. The constructed abelian sheaf inverse image is a composite of the sheaf inclusion, this left Kan extension and sheafification, each preserving finite limits. Its continuous sheaf adjunction then makes T preserve injectives by Adjunction.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_preservesFiniteLimits. This proves the private helper pushforward_injectives without an underlying-set comparison.

T preserves finite limits because its composite with the limit-reflecting sheaf inclusion is precomposition after the source sheaf inclusion. For each F choose Mathlib injectiveResolution F. Construct mapResolution T I explicitly: its complex is T applied degreewise, its terms are injective by the preceding step, and its augmentation is fromSingle₀Equiv applied to T.map (I.ι.f 0). At degree zero KernelFork.mapIsLimit preserves the augmentation kernel. At every successor degree, isoRightDerivedObj transports the assumed zero higher derived image to zero homology, proving the augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. Thus P F hF is an actual injective resolution of T(F), with no data chosen from a mere unproved existence theorem.

The functor identity T composed with Z equals E supplies Iso.refl. Apply mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and whisker with homology to obtain ec in every degree. Define c F hF n by composing the resolution computation (P F hF).isoRightDerivedObj Z, the component of ec, and the inverse of (I F).isoRightDerivedObj E; convert this categorical isomorphism to an additive equivalence.

For φ : F -> G use InjectiveResolution.desc φ (I G) (I F). Its degree-zero augmentation identity desc_commutes_zero remains true after applying T. Apply isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality to the pushed resolutions and isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality to the original resolutions. Naturality of ec combines these two squares into the naturality square for c; ConcreteCategory.congr_hom evaluates this categorical equality at x. Mathlib already incorporates independence up to homotopy, so the separate uniqueness-of-lifts theorem is unnecessary. The construction handles zero coefficients and empty schemes without additional assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleZariskiDerivedSectionsAcyclicLeray
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    [i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology]
    [(i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits i] :
    let T := i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology
    let Z := sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤)
    let E := sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op (i.obj ⊤))
    ∃ c : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero ((T.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F)) (n : ℕ),
        ((Z.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj (T.obj F)) ≃+
          ((E.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F),
      ∀ (F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero ((T.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F))
        (hG : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero ((T.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj G))
        (φ : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) (x : (Z.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj (T.obj F)),
        c G hG n ((Z.rightDerived (n + 1)).map (T.map φ) x) =
          (E.rightDerived (n + 1)).map φ (c F hF n x)
